question_en: What is the render props pattern?
answer_vi: Render props là technique chia sẻ code giữa components dùng prop là function trả về React element. Component nhận function prop gọi nó với internal state/logic: `<Mouse render={({ x, y }) => <Cat x={x} y={y} />} />`. Linh hoạt hơn HOC vì tránh naming collisions. Custom hooks giờ thường là giải pháp cleaner hơn.
answer_en: Render props is a technique for sharing code between components using a prop that is a function returning a React element. The component calls the function prop with its internal state or logic: `<Mouse render={({ x, y }) => <Cat x={x} y={y} />} />`. It is more flexible than HOCs because it avoids naming collisions. Custom hooks are now generally the cleaner alternative.
